
1) Data Preparation and Gene Selection:

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                              DATA PREPARATION
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Set the path to the folder containing the data files
file_path <- "/Users/patriciapetrova/Dartmouth/HSE711/FinalProject/"

# Read in the RNA-seq count data using read.csv()
# Setting check.names = FALSE keeps the original TCGA barcodes with hyphens 
# instead of converting them to dots.
rna_df <- read.csv(paste0(file_path,"counts.csv"), 
                   row.names = 1, 
                   check.names = FALSE)

# Read in the metadata using read.csv()
meta_df <- read.csv(paste0(file_path,"meta_data.csv"), 
                    check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

# Create a gene key for gene/ID mapping
# Gene names and Ensembl IDs were checked against human gene records
# https://www.genenames.org/
gene_key <- data.frame(
  Gene = c("GATA3", "FOXA1", "FUCA2", "KRIT1", "RAD52",
           "RPAP3", "MSL3", "AGA", "TNPO3", "GCN1"),
  Ensembl_ID = c("ENSG00000107485.18", "ENSG00000129514.8",
                 "ENSG00000001036.14", "ENSG00000001631.16",
                 "ENSG00000002016.18", "ENSG00000005175.10",
                 "ENSG00000005302.19", "ENSG00000038002.9",
                 "ENSG00000064419.13", "ENSG00000089154.11")
)

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                              SELECT GENES
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# GATA3
gata3_id <- gene_key$Ensembl_ID[gene_key$Gene == "GATA3"]

# FOXA1
foxa1_id <- gene_key$Ensembl_ID[gene_key$Gene == "FOXA1"]

# Display the selected genes ID
gata3_id
foxa1_id

# Create the data frame for selected genes
gene_df <- data.frame(
  barcode = colnames(rna_df),
  GATA3 = as.numeric(rna_df[gata3_id, ]),
  FOXA1 = as.numeric(rna_df[foxa1_id, ])
)

# Combine counts and metadata for the summaries and plots
analysis_df <- gene_df %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "barcode")

# Check if the barcodes in the analysis_df match the barcodes in the rna_df columns
stopifnot(nrow(analysis_df) == ncol(rna_df),
          identical(analysis_df$barcode, colnames(rna_df)))

# Create log-transformed GATA3 and FOXA1 variables
analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(log2_GATA3 = log2(GATA3 + 1),
         log2_FOXA1 = log2(FOXA1 + 1),
         PAM50 = factor(paper_BRCA_Subtype_PAM50, 
                        levels = c("Basal", "Her2", "LumA", "LumB", "Normal")),
         Stage = factor(gsub("_", " ", paper_pathologic_stage),
                        levels = c("Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage IV")))

# Create the PAM50 subset dataframe to use in visualizations including PAM50 subtypes
pam50_df <- analysis_df %>% filter(!is.na(PAM50))

# Reuse the same palette and display label in every visualization
pam50_colors <- c("Basal"  = "#E41A1C",
                  "Her2"   = "#E78AC3",
                  "LumA"   = "#377EB8",
                  "LumB"   = "#4DAF4A",
                  "Normal" = "#8D7F72")

pam50_display <- c("Basal" = "Basal-like", 
                   "Her2" = "HER2-enriched",
                   "LumA" = "Luminal A", 
                   "LumB" = "Luminal B",
                   "Normal" = "Normal-like")

stage_colors <- c("Stage I" = "#fee5d9", 
                  "Stage II" = "#fcae91",
                  "Stage III" = "#fb6a4a", 
                  "Stage IV" = "#cb181d")

# Prepare long data for the faceted ridgeline plot
ridge_df <- pam50_df %>%
  select(barcode, PAM50, GATA3, FOXA1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(GATA3, FOXA1), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(log2_count = log2(Count + 1),
         Gene = factor(Gene, levels = c("GATA3", "FOXA1")))

# Prepare the heatmap matrix and annotations 
meta_heatmap <- pam50_df
heatmap_counts <- as.matrix(rna_df[gene_key$Ensembl_ID,
                                   meta_heatmap$barcode, drop = FALSE])
stopifnot(identical(colnames(heatmap_counts), meta_heatmap$barcode))

# Log2-transform the raw counts
# Adding 1 prevents issues when a count is equal to 0
heatmap_log <- log2(heatmap_counts + 1)

# Convert each gene to z-scores across samples
heatmap_z <- t(scale(t(heatmap_log)))

# Greate gene labels
gene_labels <- gene_key$Gene[match(rownames(heatmap_z), gene_key$Ensembl_ID)]

# Create the heatmap annotation 
sample_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  PAM50 = meta_heatmap$PAM50,
  Stage = meta_heatmap$Stage,
  col = list(PAM50 = pam50_colors, Stage = stage_colors),
  na_col = "grey80"
)

# Correlations use exactly the same 1,099 profiles as BOTH scatter plots
r_raw <- cor(pam50_df$GATA3, pam50_df$FOXA1)
r_log2 <- cor(pam50_df$log2_GATA3, pam50_df$log2_FOXA1)
```

2) Summary Statistics:

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                              SUMMARY STATISTICS
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Calculate summary statistics
summary_stats <- gene_df %>%
  select(GATA3, FOXA1) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Count") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarize(Mean = mean(Count), SD = sd(Count), Median = median(Count),
            Q1 = quantile(Count, 0.25, names = FALSE),
            Q3 = quantile(Count, 0.75, names = FALSE),
            Minimum = min(Count), Maximum = max(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = c("GATA3", "FOXA1"))) %>%
  arrange(Gene)

gene_table <- kable(summary_stats, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
                     caption = "Summary Statistics for GATA3 and FOXA1 Raw Cunts") %>% 
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"))
gene_table

write.csv(summary_stats, "tables/gene_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

3) Visualization:
a) Histogram:

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                                  HISTOGRAM
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Statistics for the vertical lines
m_mean <- summary_stats[["Mean"]][1]
m_median <- summary_stats[["Median"]][1] 

# Create the histogram
p_hist <- ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = GATA3)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "#2c3e50", fill = "darkblue", alpha = 0.7) + 
  # Vertical line for the mean
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = m_mean, color = "Mean"), 
             linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1, key_glyph = "path") +
  # Vertical line for the median
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = m_median, color = "Median"), 
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, key_glyph = "path") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mean" = "#D3624D", "Median" = "#D4AF37")) +
  labs(x = "Raw RNA-seq Counts", y = "Number of Samples", color = NULL,
       title = expression(paste(bold("Distribution of "), 
                                bolditalic("GATA3"), 
                                bold(" Expression")))) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"))
p_hist

ggsave("figures/figure1_histogram.pdf", p_hist, width = 8, height = 4.8)
```

b) Scatter Plot:

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                              SCATTER PLOT
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
p_raw <- ggplot(pam50_df, aes(x = GATA3, y = FOXA1, color = PAM50)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pam50_colors, labels = pam50_display) +
  labs(title = "Raw counts", 
        x = expression(italic("GATA3")),
        y = expression(italic("FOXA1")), color = "PAM50 Subtype") +
  # parse = TRUE tells ggplot2 to treat the label text as a plotmath expression 
  # instead of printing it literally.
  # without parse = TRUE, the r is shown exactly as text: italic(r) == 0.761
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = paste0("italic(r) == ", round(r_raw, 3)),
           parse = TRUE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

p_log <- ggplot(pam50_df, aes(x = log2_GATA3, y = log2_FOXA1, color = PAM50)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pam50_colors, labels = pam50_display) +
  labs(title = "Log2-transformed counts",
       x = expression(log[2]~"("*italic("GATA3")~" + 1)"),
       y = expression(log[2]~"("*italic("FOXA1")~" + 1)"),
       color = "PAM50 Subtype") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = paste0("italic(r) == ", round(r_log2, 3)),
           parse = TRUE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

scatter_panel <- ggarrange(p_raw, p_log, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, 
                           legend = "bottom", align = "hv")

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/65694397/add-main-title-multiple-plots-ggarange
scatter_panel <- annotate_figure(
  scatter_panel, top = text_grob(expression(paste(bolditalic("GATA3"), bold(" vs. "), 
                                                  bolditalic("FOXA1"))), size = 14))
scatter_panel
ggsave("figures/figure2_scatter_comparison.pdf", scatter_panel,
       width = 11, height = 4.8)
```

c) Violin Plot:

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                              VIOLIN PLOT
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Calculate the number of samples in each PAM 50 subtype
pam50_n <- table(pam50_df$PAM50)

violin_p <- ggplot(pam50_df, aes(x = PAM50, y = log2_GATA3, fill = PAM50)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", alpha = 0.8, 
               outlier.color = "gray25", outlier.size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pam50_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    paste0(pam50_display[x], "\n(n = ", pam50_n[x], ")")
  }) +
  labs(title = expression(paste(bolditalic("GATA3"), bold(" Distribution by PAM50 Subtype"))),
       x = "PAM50 subtype",
       y = expression(log[2]~"("*italic("GATA3")~" + 1)")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
violin_p

ggsave("figures/figure3_violinplot.pdf", violin_p, width = 9, height = 5)
```

d) Heatmap: 

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                                  HEATMAP
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
heatmap_p <- Heatmap(heatmap_z, 
                     name = "Z-score", 
                     row_labels = gene_labels,
                     top_annotation = sample_annotation,
                     show_row_names = TRUE, 
                     show_column_names = FALSE,
                     column_title = "Samples", 
                     row_title = "Selected genes", 
                     row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize = 10),
                     column_split = meta_heatmap$PAM50,
                     cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
                     cluster_rows = TRUE, 
                     cluster_columns = TRUE)
draw(heatmap_p)
pdf("figures/figure4_heatmap.pdf", width = 10, height = 5.8)
draw(heatmap_p)
dev.off()
```
e) Additional plot: Ridgeline Plot

```{r}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#                              RIDGELINE PLOT
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
p_ridge <- ggplot(ridge_df, aes(x = log2_count, y = PAM50, fill = PAM50)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8, scale = 1.05, color = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pam50_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = pam50_display) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, nrow = 1) +
  labs(title = "Expression Distributions by PAM50 Subtype",
       x = expression(log[2]~"(Count + 1)"), y = "PAM50 subtype") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold.italic"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black"),
        panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"))
p_ridge

ggsave("figures/figure5_ridgelines.pdf", p_ridge, width = 9, height = 5.2)
```
